decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established offer, has its own web page and fits the announced consumer health expansion, so management stays committed to it.
This skin and hair supplement was promoted publicly as new in pharmacies and builds on the established offer, so its visibility and fit with the strategy favor keeping it.
The joint supplement was announced as new within the Trivital line, so the public commitment and its fit with the consumer health direction argue for persisting.
The mushroom immune supplement is only mentioned on the website, but it is a low-cost line extension within the established supplement offer, so there is little pressure to withdraw it this early.

The 2018 valsartan problem points to a supplier contamination that can be seen as temporary, and generics broadening is part of the announced direction, so management is more likely to re-source than exit, although the product is distant from its core.
